verdict.rationale: Reducto documents its own OCR inside Parse and Extract. Parse is said to handle rotated pages and forms with handwriting, which partly covers hard scans. No evidence addresses skewed photographs, stamps or low-quality scans specifically, and there is no accuracy benchmark or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit support for skewed or photographed pages, stamp handling, low-quality scan robustness, independent accuracy evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, scanned and photographed documents OCR accurately — skewed pages, stamps, low quality scans included
